description: Use this for which house builders are selling new homes in a place, with how many developments and homes each has there; or for one builder by name: its developments with homes for sale and prices, when it was founded, its parent group, what it says about itself, and the awards its own website lists. Give a place, a builder, or both.

builder.description: A house builder by name, for example Barratt Homes or Taylor Wimpey.

place.description: A town, city, county, council area, postcode district or full postcode (within 10 miles of it).

place_option.description: Which of several places with that name, by the option a previous call returned.

name: find_builders
title: Find house builders
